harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-settings-receipt-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-21: zoo owner, "yes define it" (the contract check of #539's receipt; a pilot, 36 games, all classes).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#539; borg-reborn-rs #798). A contract check of the
adapter in PR #554, with the first build that writes the receipt; the games themselves are not the question.
Gate: one binary; no config_error; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified.
Contract: every cell has settings_resolved with status ok (36 of 36), its sha256 equal to the retained
settings-resolved.json, class_name equal to the played class; for the override arm and each class the projection
verdicts are as follows. Rangers: town_phase_reserve__ranger match (3), the Mage key not applicable, the scalar
town_phase_reserve_percent match (150), the alias not applicable. Mages: town_phase_reserve__mage match (1),
attack_preference_mage_spell_permille (the alias) match (1600), the scalar match. Warriors: town_phase_reserve__warrior
omitted (equal to the default 0). Any other class: the class keys not applicable, the scalar match. ctl cells: receipt
ok; the map holds the shipped values that differ from the compiled defaults (the shipped borg.txt sets many); no projection. Report any cell with another verdict, a malformed receipt, or a
receipt that disagrees with params-core.json for the same name.

A contract check, not a comparison.
